intro: Government and financial services feature among the sectors most affected across 21 incident-response articles published between 13 April and 25 September 2026. Reporting spans the United States, APAC, Australia, CIS, and Europe, and covers government, financial services, cybersecurity, technology, and cloud computing. CVE-2025-59718, rated CVSS 9.8, is the most prominent vulnerability referenced. The severity mix comprises 11 high-severity items, two critical, one medium, and one informational. Coverage examines how organisations detect, contain, and recover from intrusions across these regions and industries.
